'''Josh Gilliom''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (22 July)]] on 22 July 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down podracing]], according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2711">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-25-colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01d2711/ colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 25 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-25-colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01d2711/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
